lines.en: label makotofirsthall:
scene makhall1
: Hey Makoto. What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Makoto。你在忙什么？

lines.en: : Hey, Sensei...I was actually just about to go meet up with my mom for dinner, but...
lines.zh: : 嘿，老师……我其实正准备去跟我妈吃晚饭，不过……

lines.en: : Now I'm curious as to what exactly you're doing here.
lines.zh: : 现在倒是好奇你到底在这儿干什么。

lines.en: : You do realize there doesn't have to be a rule specifically advising that males are not allowed in the girls' dorm to just...know you shouldn't enter, correct?
lines.zh: : 你知道的，并不是非得有一条明确规定「男生不得进入女生宿舍」，人才……知道自己不该进来，对吧？

lines.en: : And yet here I am.
lines.zh: : 而我这不就进来了嘛。

lines.en: scene makhall2
: Though...it is rather strange that there isn't a rule barring males from entry given that there are so many other strangely specific rules in the student handbook.
lines.zh: : 不过……学生手册里那么多奇奇怪怪又具体的规定，却偏偏没有一条禁止男生进入，这倒是挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : Am I allowed to talk now or do you want to think about rules for a little while longer?
lines.zh: : 我现在可以说话了吗，还是你想再想一会儿规定？

lines.en: scene makhall3
: Apologies. Did you maybe...need something from me?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你是不是……有什么事要我帮忙？

lines.en: : All I need from you is a good conversation, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 我需要你的就是一场愉快的谈话，Makoto。

lines.en: : ...I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : ……你说什么？

lines.en: : A conversation. It's the formal word for when two normal people talk to one another.
lines.zh: : 谈话。就是两个正常人互相说话的正式说法。

lines.en: : I'm so confused. Are you implying that you came all this way, breaking several unwritten rules in the process, to do something as simple as talking?
lines.zh: : 我好懵。你是在说，你大老远跑来、还顺带违反了好几条不成文的规定，就为了「说话」这么简单的事？

lines.en: : There is no such thing as an unwritten rule. If it's not written down, it may as well not exist.
lines.zh: : 不成文的规定这种东西是不存在的。没写下来，就等于不存在。

lines.en: : I have many issues with that statement, but for the sake of our conversation, I will attempt to look past them.
lines.zh: : 我对这句话有很多意见，但为了我们这场谈话，我尽量不去计较。

lines.en: scene makhall4
: So, what would you like to talk about? I'm all ears for the next several minutes.
lines.zh: : 那么，你想聊点什么？接下来几分钟我洗耳恭听。

lines.en: : Anything really. I kind of just wanted to hang out with you and kill some time before heading home.
lines.zh: : 什么都行。我只是想跟你待一会儿，回家前打发点时间。

lines.en: if day38 == False:
scene makhall3
: Hang out? Like....me and you? Together?
lines.zh: : 待一会儿？像……我和你？在一起？

lines.en: : I had no idea that was something you were even interested in...
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道你居然对这个感兴趣……

lines.en: : Are you sure it's okay?
lines.zh: : 你确定没问题吗？

lines.en: : I can't see why it wouldn't be.
lines.zh: : 我看不出有什么不行的。

lines.en: : I am...sure you can, but...
lines.zh: : 我……想你看得出来，不过……

lines.en: scene makhall5
: I'd...love to regardless.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我……很乐意。

lines.en: else:
scene makhall1
: Hang out? Like...right now?
lines.zh: : 待一会儿？就……现在？

lines.en: : Is that a problem? We've hung out before, haven't we?
lines.zh: : 有问题吗？我们以前也一起待过吧？

lines.en: scene makhall5
: Yes, it's just...
lines.zh: : 是，只是……

lines.en: : I wish I knew you were planning on hanging out with me before I made plans with my mom.
lines.zh: : 我要是早知道你打算跟我待一会儿，就不会跟我妈约好了。

lines.en: : I can always come back some other time if you're busy. It's no big deal.
lines.zh: : 你忙的话我可以改天再来。没什么大不了的。

lines.en: scene makhall3
: Hmm...Well, I suppose it wouldn't hurt to spare a few minutes.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧，我想腾出几分钟也不碍事。

lines.en: : Is your mom going to be okay with you being late?
lines.zh: : 你妈妈会介意你迟到吗？

lines.en: : Honestly, I doubt she would have shown up on time anyway...so it's not really a big deal.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我怀疑她本来也不会准时到……所以其实也没什么大不了的。

lines.en: scene makhall7
: And, in the event that she's actually on time for once, I can just tell her I was helping out the teacher.
lines.zh: : 而且万一她这次真的准时了，我就可以跟她说我在帮老师的忙。

lines.en: : Great idea. Feel free to use me as an excuse whenever you want, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 好主意。随时欢迎拿我当借口，Makoto。

lines.en: : To be perfectly honest, Sensei, I have been doing that all year. But I'm glad to know that my occasional tardiness is now teacher-approved.
lines.zh: : 老实说，老师，我一整年都在这么干了。不过很高兴知道我偶尔的迟到现在得到了老师的官方认证。

lines.en: scene makhall1
: Oh, speaking of which...I don't think I've ever asked you why you decided to teach at a high school instead of a college or...night school or something.
lines.zh: : 哦，说到这个……我想我从没问过你，为什么选择在高中教书，而不是大学或者……夜校什么的。

lines.en: : Was there any reason behind that choice? How different is the salary of a high school teacher compared to that of a college professor?
lines.zh: : 这个选择有什么原因吗？高中老师和大学教授的薪水差多少？

lines.en: : What sort of benefits are offered? And, in terms of job security-
lines.zh: : 福利怎么样？还有在职业稳定性方面——

lines.en: : Makoto, chill. That's way too many questions at once.
lines.zh: : Makoto，冷静。一次问太多了。

lines.en: scene makhall3
: Sorry...it's just-
lines.zh: : 抱歉……只是——

lines.en: : Well, you know how badly I want to be a teacher one day.
lines.zh: : 你知道我有多想有一天当上老师。

lines.en: I guess I do now.
lines.zh: 我想我现在知道了。

lines.en: : And I'm sure it might be premature to begin thinking about it now, but I've yet to decide on which level I want to teach at.
lines.zh: : 而且我确信现在就开始想这个可能太早，但我还没决定要教哪个阶段。

lines.en: : I think I'd be best off with college students, but...I also lack a formal college education right now, so I could be very, very wrong about that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我可能最适合教大学生，不过……我现在也还没受过正规的大学教育，所以这方面我可能错得非常、非常离谱。

lines.en: : Well, unfortunately, I don't think I'll be of much help to you right now.
lines.zh: : 唉，可惜，我觉得我现在帮不上你什么忙。

lines.en: : I have literally no idea how I wound up where I am and...honestly? I'm not sure if I ever will.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道自己是怎么走到今天这一步的，而且……说实话？我不确定我以后会不会知道。

lines.en: scene makhall1
: What do you mean by that, exactly?
lines.zh: : 你这话到底是什么意思？

lines.en: : Are you saying that...life is so unpredictable that even the most focused individuals can get hurled down an unexpected path entirely at random?
lines.zh: : 你是说……人生不可预测到这种地步，连最专注的人都可能被整个随机地甩上一条意想不到的路？

lines.en: : Sure, let's go with that.
lines.zh: : 行，就这么理解吧。

lines.en: scene makhall8
: Hmm...I see.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我明白了。

lines.en: : I guess I never thought of it that way.
lines.zh: : 我想我从来没往那方面想过。

lines.en: : I suppose it would be best to just...not focus on that for now then.
lines.zh: : 我想最好还是……暂时别想那个了。

lines.en: scene makhall9
: At the very least, it will give me a bit more time to focus on keeping a certain someone in check.
lines.zh: : 至少，这能让我有更多时间专注于管住某一个人。

lines.en: : Good idea, Makoto. Miku needs all the help she can get.
lines.zh: : 好主意，Makoto。Miku 需要一切能得到的帮助。

lines.en: : I was talking about you, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我说的是你，老师……

lines.en: scene black
Makoto and I talk for another few minutes before she decides it’s best to start heading over to wherever she's meeting her mom.
lines.zh: Makoto 和我又聊了几分钟，之后她决定该动身去跟她妈妈碰面的地方了。

lines.en: I think for a moment about what she would be like as a teacher, but ultimately get sucked into a fantasy I would prefer to not tell you about.
lines.zh: 我想了一会儿她当老师会是什么样子，但最终陷进了一个我不太想告诉你的幻想里。

lines.en: Either way, the night comes to an end. But not before the two of us manage to get a little bit closer...
lines.zh: 不管怎样，这一晚就这么结束了。但在那之前，我俩还是又靠近了一点……

lines.zh: Makoto 的好感度提升到了 [makoto_love]！
